subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 executable action revisions—including `openai/codex-action` v1.11's GitHub-hosted Linux user-namespace/AppArmor setup—as the new workflow security baseline?
rationale: The patch has no mechanical defect, but it replaces third-party code running with credentials and changes runner security state; repository intent is required to accept that boundary.

options.title: Approve the exact revision batch
options.body: Accept the upstream changes after reviewing the privileged action families and confirming stable exact-head workflow results.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and container-publishing actions from routine setup and repository-automation updates for narrower review.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Close or pause this bot PR and allow narrower dependency updates when a workflow owner can review them.
